title: Kuiper TTS: Making Legacy Scientific Papers Accessible by Converting Equations into Spoken Language
abstract: Kuiper TTS is an end-to-end pipeline for converting academic PDFs — including mathematical equations — into structured LaTeX and spoken audio, making legacy scientific literature accessible to visually impaired researchers. The system integrates layout detection, equation OCR, LLM-based LaTeX reconstruction, and neural TTS with per-stage validation and C++-based production inference.

title: Read the Math: Improving Mathematics Education Using Vision-Accessibility Techniques
abstract: Applies vision-accessibility techniques to improve how mathematical content is parsed, rendered, and communicated in educational contexts, enabling more inclusive math education through document understanding and structured output pipelines.

title: VR Arena: Virtual Reality-Based Entertainment for Society
abstract: VR Arena presents a virtual reality arena environment designed for immersive entertainment and training scenarios, describing the system design, interaction model, and potential applications for social and educational use.
